messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not start new medication without telling doctor"
set: ["do not start new medication without telling doctor", "do not start or stop without asking doctor", "do not start or stop without doctor's advice", "do not stop using asthma medication without doctor's advice", "do not switch to schedule without doctor", "do not switch without doctor changing dose", "do not start or stop during pregnancy without doctor's advice", "if stopped for several days, do not start again without talking to doctor", "do not change doses or medication schedule without doctor's advice", "do not stop without speaking to your doctor", "do not start or stop any other medicine without checking first", "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor", "do not stop using without first asking your doctor", "do not stop using without first talking to your doctor", "do not change dose without doctor's advice", "do not change dose or stop without speaking to doctor first"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "do not start or stop without asking doctor",
    "do not start or stop without doctor's advice",
    "do not start or stop during pregnancy without doctor's advice",
    "do not start or stop any other medicine without checking first",
    "do not stop without speaking to your doctor",
    "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor",
    "do not stop using without first asking your doctor",
    "do not stop using without first talking to your doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "do not start or stop without doctor's advice"
}
